column1: # 三國志14 with 威力加強版 on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# Koei Tecmo's KTGL on NVN, SDK 10.4.1, update 1.1.1; 55,391 shaders split into 55,383 and all translated.
# Tested 2026-11-16/17 on a Xiaomi 2410DPN6CC (haotian, Snapdragon 8 Elite, Adreno 830, Android 16): the logos, the
# title screen, the settings screen (every row drawn and switchable), a new game from the faction select through the
# opening narration into the campaign map, a city panel opened by tapping its city, the officer list, and a save that
# the game commits #7 without an error. 30 fps as on the Switch: frame time p50 33.3 ms, 0 frames dropped on screen,
# GPU 20.7 ms and replay 2.6 ms a frame on the map; audio 0 underruns over 48,000 frames with 5 catch-up renders.
# 60 fps was investigated and is GPU-bound on this device (see the note).
# Two things this game needed beyond the SDK's defaults, both described in this folder's README.md: the audio renderer's work buffer is sized by the
# renderer service's budget rather than by the local SDK's CPU/manual size (KTGL's internal pools have only a few hundred bytes to spare, and the extra
# 1.37 MB pushed one of them over — the subsystem's process step returned -51 and the game tore audio down and exited), and nn::fs's option-word
# QueryMountRomCacheSize / MountRom overloads. No env switches and no code cuts.
